articles.summary: MERRILLVILLE, Ind. – NiSource Inc. (NYSE: NI) announced today a new long-term energy agreement with Microsoft for its previously announced northwest Indiana campus. The agreement is expected to expand customer savings while supporting economic growth across the region, reflecting NiSource’s continued focus on aligning economic development with customer affordability.
articles.title: NiSource announces long-term agreement with Microsoft expected to increase customer savings and support Indiana’s economic growth

articles.summary: MERRILLVILLE, Ind. – NiSource Inc. (NYSE: NI) today announced that it will deliver $57.5 million in savings to its existing electric customers generated through data center development. Subject to regulatory approval, the average residential electric customer is expected to receive a monthly bill credit of approximately $5 for 18 months, beginning approximately 30 days after approval.
articles.title: NIPSCO to deliver $57.5 million in savings to electric customers from data center development

articles.summary: MERRILLVILLE, Ind. – NiSource Inc. (NYSE: NI) today announced that the company will release third quarter 2026 financial results on October 28, 2026, before US financial markets open and will host a conference call that day at 11 a.m. EDT (10 a.m. CT) to review third quarter 2026 financial results and provide a general business update
articles.title: NiSource to release third quarter 2026 financial results and host conference call on October 28

articles.summary: MERRILLVILLE, Ind. - NiSource Inc. (NYSE: NI) today announced, on a GAAP basis, net income available to common shareholders for the quarter ended September 30, 2026 of $129.5 million, or $0.27 of earnings per diluted share, compared to net income available to common shareholders of $94.7 million, or $0.20 of earnings per diluted share, for the same period of 2025. For the nine months ended September 30, 2026, on a GAAP basis, NiSource's net income available to common shareholders was $685.7 million, or $1.42 of diluted earnings per share, compared to net income available to common shareholders of $671.7 million, or $1.42 of diluted earnings per share, for the same period of 2025.
articles.title: NiSource announces third quarter results
